name: @ariada-org/gitlab-component
description: GitLab CI/CD component for the Ariada differential accessibility gate.

scripts.lint: ruby -e 'require "yaml"; ARGV.each { |f| YAML.load_stream(File.read(f)); puts "ok #{f}" }' templates/ariada-diff.yml examples/component-include.yml
scripts.test: grep -q 'ariada diff classify' templates/ariada-diff.yml && grep -q 'ariada diff gate' templates/ariada-diff.yml
